IC1: Preoperative renal failure (defined as a serum creatinine > 2.0 mg/dL.)
IC2: American Society of Anesthesiologists Physical Status IV or V
IC3: Pulmonary disease necessitating home oxygen therapy
IC4: Allergy to methadone, hydromorphone, or ketamine
IC5: Preoperative recent history of opioid or  [OR]alcohol abuse
IC7: Inability to use a [OR] PCA [AND] device or speak the English language
